name: requests
description: Upstream non-security HTTP adapter URL-formatting bug fixed by PR #6644 in February 2024. A valid path with excess leading separators and a colon is passed to urllib3 in a form that it interprets as an invalid authority. The regression and repair are the complete upstream test-only and source-only changes, respectively, from the fix commit against its immediate parent.
question: Fix HTTPAdapter.request_url so direct HTTP requests with excess leading path separators and a colon in the path produce the expected path-only request target. Preserve the remaining path and existing proxy URL behavior.

validation.dependency_release_date_source: https://pypi.org/pypi/{package}/{version}/json, checked 2026-09-21. All files for every pinned release are older than 2026-09-14 and none are yanked.
validation.dependency_policy: pytest 6.2.5 satisfies the historical requirements-dev.txt upper bound. urllib3 2.2.1, idna 3.6, and charset-normalizer 3.3.2 match the issue's reported dependency versions. All direct and transitive dependencies needed by the selected module are pinned and installed from wheels with --no-deps. Optional HTTP-server/coverage/SOCKS extras are unnecessary for this module. pip check passes.
validation.workspace_metadata: No distribution metadata or build backend is needed. Requests is imported from workspace/src and is never installed into the venv. The setup checks the complete installed distribution inventory and rejects any mismatch on reuse without installing or changing dependencies.
system_dependencies: git and tar for archive preparation
Linux unshare for validation network isolation
Node.js for directly exercising the existing harness functions
validation.suite_selection: The entire upstream adapter test module tests/test_adapters.py, introduced by this upstream fix. This is the standard module directly owning HTTPAdapter.request_url. It contains one genuine upstream regression test. Requests is a large HTTP client with separate integration, utility, and other test modules; those are outside this adapter-module contract. No tests were added, duplicated, or filtered to alter diagnostic length or expected pruning/model success.

predeclared_exclusions.rationale: No exclusions within the selected module. It prepares a Request and calls request_url without sending a request, starting a server, or looking up a hostname. Diagnostics and verification run in a Linux network namespace with no external network. Existing upstream doctest options and warnings are unchanged.

candidate_selection.selection_basis: Documented non-security defect, exact single-file source fix and real regression in the upstream owning test module, deterministic Linux/Python 3.12 execution without network or external services.
candidate_selection.previous_use_check: Fetched all origin branches in jev-pruner. git log --all -- evals/historical/requests and git log --all -G 'psf/requests|60389df6|6643|6644' -- evals returned no matches. Existing historical cases are click, flask, pytest, pip, and hatch.

preflight_only.reason: JSONDecodeError pickle round-trip fix examined, but its owning test_requests module also requires local HTTP/TLS servers. Not runtime-attempted; chose a directly scoped, network-free module instead.
String Content-Length encoding fix examined, but contract varies with urllib3 major version and its tests use the HTTP fixture module. Not runtime-attempted.
Optional character detector support examined; no regression test diff in this commit. Not runtime-attempted.
Documentation-only change, no runtime repair or regression. Not runtime-attempted.

candidate_selection.shallow_checks: jev-pruner and requests-upstream each reported false before any history search; no unshallow step was needed. History searches were scoped to evals, source, or tests paths.
candidate_selection.stop_rule: Stop after two seriously attempted candidates fail; the first runtime-attempted candidate validated, with no failed candidates.

patch_provenance.checks: Patches compare byte-for-byte with upstream git diff. The fix is a single-parent upstream commit and its parent resolves exactly to base_commit. The entire fix changes only these two files: 8 inserted test lines and 3 inserted source lines. Applied regression and repaired source compare byte-for-byte with upstream fix blobs. LICENSE and NOTICE are unmodified upstream files.

commands.context: Actual paths from this validation. Each pytest process uses cwd equal to its workspace and the case environment, with PYTEST_ADDOPTS='', NO_COLOR=1, and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 supplied by the unchanged harness. Replace root paths when reproducing.
commands.direct_harness_calls: Imported cases, diagnostic, testCounts, and grade from the unchanged evals/codex-historical-workloads.mjs. Set cases.requests to this case.json only in validation process memory and JEV_HISTORICAL_CACHE=/home/ubuntu/requests-validation/cache. Called diagnostic('requests', baseline), diagnostic('requests', fixed, false), diagnostic('requests', fixed, true), then wrote fixed_counts to the private cache's validation.json and called grade('requests', fixed). Called diagnostic('requests', baseline, true) again after venv reuse. The external validation script only asserts invariants and records measurements; it is not required by setup or diagnostic_args.
commands.oracle_contract: The actual grade function calls prepare to copy the untouched broken baseline into a fresh oracle directory and copies only src/requests/adapters.py from fixed before running verify_args. No model or comparison code is invoked.
commands.whitespace_check: git diff --cached --check -- evals/historical/requests/case.json evals/historical/requests/setup.sh evals/historical/requests/LICENSE evals/historical/requests/NOTICE

validation.measurement: Counts come from the actual harness testCounts parser. Output length is the unpadded combined stdout/stderr decoded as UTF-8, returned by diagnostic; stderr outside that stream was empty. Wall seconds come from the harness execute function; pytest seconds come from its summary. All runs finished without timeout in under one second. Paths, timings, and warning locations may affect byte lengths on another machine.

archive_contract.network_isolation: The entire validation Node process, all diagnostic and grading Python children, and reuse setups ran inside unshare --user --map-current-user --net. /proc/net/route contained only its header. No network service or DNS is needed.
archive_contract.integrity_details: SHA-256 manifests cover all source, tests, configuration, documentation, and packaged fixture files in each archive. Only newly generated __pycache__ and .pytest_cache directories are omitted. Baseline remains broken after the same venv is used by fixed and oracle, detecting accidental source binding.

known_gaps: This case validates the complete adapter test module at the fix commit: one upstream regression. It does not run Requests' separate HTTP/TLS integration suite or other modules and does not claim their coverage.

Historical pytest 6.2.5 emits 18 Python 3.12 AST deprecation warnings in both states. The historical pytest requirement and all warning behavior are preserved; no warning suppression, config override, or filters were added.

git diff --check flags the two single-space blank context lines in the embedded upstream repair.patch (lines 7 and 14). These are required unified-diff context, retained byte-for-byte. All non-patch fixture files pass whitespace checks.
Initial setup downloads pinned PyPI wheels. Repeated setup and all diagnostic/grading runs were validated offline.
Shared case registration was intentionally not changed; the parent evaluator must register requests before running its authorized trials.
restrictions: No Codex, Jev, model comparison, or trial execution.
No security defect, artificial injection, credential handling, or exploit.
No changed tests except the exact upstream regression diff; no configuration or warning changes.
No repair patch or repaired source in the broken baseline.
No editable installation or installed Requests duplicate; all imports resolve to each workspace.
Only evals/historical/requests is committed; no shared registration or harness change.
